hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"; case "$f" in */back/src/*.ts) (cd "$root/back" && ./node_modules/.bin/prettier --write "$f");; */front/disciplina-front/src/*.ts|*/front/disciplina-front/src/*.tsx) (cd "$root/front/disciplina-front" && ./node_modules/.bin/eslint --fix "$f");; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
